title: Artinian infinitesimal lifting criterion for smoothness at a point
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with $S$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $x\in X$. A *small extension* is a surjective ring homomorphism $\varphi:B'\to B$ of Artinian local rings whose kernel $I=\ker\varphi$ has length $1$ as a $B'$-module (so $I\cong B'/\mathfrak m_{B'}$, $\mathfrak m_{B'}I=0$ and $I^2=0$); write $i=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}B'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The following are equivalent:

(1) $f$ is smooth at $x$: there is an open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$ such that $f|_U:U\to S$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms];

(2) for every small extension $\varphi:B'\to B$ and every pair of morphisms of schemes $\alpha:\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$, $\beta:\operatorname{Spec}B'\to S$ with $f\circ\alpha=\beta\circ i$ and $\alpha$ mapping the closed (unique) point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ to $x$, there is a morphism $\gamma:\operatorname{Spec}B'\to X$ with $\gamma\circ i=\alpha$ and $f\circ\gamma=\beta$.

(This is Stacks 02HX, (1)$\Leftrightarrow$(3). Stacks defines smoothness at $x$ by an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A\ni x$ over an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $R\to A$ a smooth ring map, Morphisms Definition 01V5; this is equivalent to (1) because smoothness is local on the source, Morphisms Lemma 01V6, and the smooth morphisms of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] are those of Morphisms Section 01V4 by More on Morphisms Lemma 02H6.)
